checks.fidelity: I checked the definitions against RamcovGX.tex l.2237 (D) and ETT defi:causal_Ealpha / defi:causal_E0. btzPaperNull = (2τ + rθ² − r, r, −rθ) is D in null coordinates (a = t+x, b = t−x, c = y, Q = −ab + c²). Le means 'some lifts are D-causally related'. Off the axis this agrees with the chart order: the principal winding minimises r₁r₂(Δθ+2πk)², as Le.of_polar shows. The causality is ETT's, built from curves, as DEC-33 requires: CLe/CLt are existence of a Causal.CurveOn for the local relation in U, and they agree globally with Le/Lt via straight segments read back by unlift. This works because J⁺(Δ) ∪ {b>0} is convex along future vectors (adm_seg). Nothing trivialises the notion. I checked the closed forms by hand: I⁺(p) = {r>0, τ − r/2 > τ_p} and J⁻(p) = {r = 0, τ ≤ τ_p} at BTZ p. The calculus 0 ≤ Δr ≤ 2Δτ is the integral of −2τ̇ṙ + ṙ² + r²θ̇² ≤ 0. DEC-64's Iplus_of_lt is proved. The counterexample to the old Iplus_eq is correct: (τ_p+1/2, r=1) has f = τ_p. coneSliceFuture_Y matches LocalModel.coneSliceFuture (CBG/Geometry.lean:679) verbatim, with singY 0 := inr '' axis. The hypothesis of coneSlicePast_Y_of_axis is exactly the BTZ case of the field, nothing more. absolutelyMinimalOn_Y matches its field. The ledger row is honest: the lemma is about every BTZ- and BTZ~-manifold, while the file proves only the model 𝔼₀ (and Y), with Causal's CausallyArcConnected, which is at least as strong as def:singular_manifold_endowed_causal. `partial`, unmarked, is the right status.

issues.where: Causality.lean:2344-2363 GX.E0.coneSlicePast_Y_of_axis; REPORT notes NOT DONE (2); SCOPE (b)
issues.problem: The dispatch item 'coneSlicePast (at BTZ: K = J⁺_O(y) ∩ {τ + r = c}, c slightly above τ(y))' is not discharged. BARBOT-INTERFACE.md (round 4) also lists it among gx's E₀ obligations. The file proves the field at every non-BTZ point and takes the BTZ case as a hypothesis. No declaration states the BTZ case, not even with a tagged sorry, so the headline '0 sorry' hides the gap from any sorry count. The report itself says 'not attempted beyond the reduction'. The obstruction it gives (N = {f > a} ∩ {h < b} is not a Cauchy development of {h = c}) rules out one choice of N, not the statement. Here is a route that looks workable. Let Γ' = {h = c} ∩ {f > τ_y − η}. For small η, Γ' ⊆ V by compactness of K = {h = c} ∩ {f ≥ τ_y}, and K lies in a box r ≤ 2(c − τ_y)/3. h is a time function strictly increasing along ≤ (hcoord_lt_of_le), and τ, r are monotone, so every future-inextensible causal curve from a point near y has h → ∞ (a bounded-h curve converges, contradicting curvesExtend/inextensibility). It therefore crosses {h = c} inside Γ'. Then take N = an open neighbourhood of y in the domain of dependence of Γ'. This is exactly the BTZ-specific content of WP-39e. Without it, LocalModel cannot be assembled for Y = 𝕄 ⊕ 𝔼₀.
issues.fix: State GX.E0.sliceAt_past_of_mem_axis : ∀ w ∈ axis, SliceAt causality w (fun O z => causality.le O w z) with K = J⁺_O(w) ∩ {hcoord = c}. Prove it by the domain-of-dependence argument above, or leave a tagged `sorry -- SORRY(coneSlicePast BTZ): …` naming the precise missing step. Then derive the unconditional coneSlicePast_Y and coneSlicePast_YBTZ (the transport is already in SliceAt.transport).

issues.where: Causality.lean:1427-1454 GX.E0.tarentin; REPORT notes NOT DONE (3)
issues.problem: The dispatch item 'diamonds a basis' is missing. Only Tarentin is proved: every point is in the interior of a diamond with vertices in a given neighbourhood. That the diamonds can be taken inside the neighbourhood is not proved. No obstruction is given, and the statement looks cheap with the file's own tools. At a regular point the sector charts transport Minkowski's diamonds. At a BTZ point p, J⁺(a) ∩ J⁻(b) with a = (τ_p − ε, 0) and b off-axis just above p lies in {τ_a ≤ τ ≤ τ_b, r ≤ r_b} (calculus_le), which is a small box around p. Note that an open I-diamond never contains a BTZ point, because I⁻(p) = ∅ and p ∉ I⁺(a). So the basis must use interiors of J-diamonds there, which is the form rem:tamifying_topology_generated_open (WP-39h) uses.
issues.fix: Prove ∀ x, ∀ U ∈ 𝓝 x, ∃ p q ∈ U, x ∈ interior (J⁺(p) ∩ J⁻(q)) ∧ J⁺(p) ∩ J⁻(q) ⊆ U, splitting into the axis case (box bound from calculus_le) and the off-axis case (sector chart plus Minkowski). Use the open diamond off the axis if that is the form downstream needs.

summary: The file builds clean: 0 sorry, standard axioms only, DEC-33 gate respected, no name clashes, and every reported declaration exists. Nothing is overclaimed. The causality of 𝔼₀ from curves is faithful to D (l.2237) and to ETT's defi:causal_Ealpha / defi:causal_E0. These are proved: the calculus, I⁺(p) at BTZ p globally and in balls, the full BTZAxioms with DEC-64's Iplus_of_lt, I^± open in every U, J^±(V) open for U = ⊤, Z^±, tarentin, absolutelyMinimalOn_Y and coneSliceFuture (also on 𝕄 ⊕ BTZE0). The one ledger row is correctly partial and unmarked. Verdict: issues. Two dispatch items are missing and are major. First, coneSlicePast at BTZ points: only a reduction exists, there is no stated or sorry-tagged BTZ case, and the obstruction given rules out one choice of N, not the statement. Second, 'diamonds a basis': only Tarentin is proved, though the basis looks cheap. Minor: chartIso_mem is deferred, justifiably, because WP-41c's groupoid was not yet available; J^±(V) openness is only the ⊤ form; pushUp and a bundled SingularFlatAxioms are missing; and the BTZE0 transport is not tied to btzE0Structure.
